"""Prepare a fresh finite phase only after the actual safe end of v6."""
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from tools.rolling_production_queue import no_calling
from tools.production_window_gate import inspect_window
previous='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v6';following='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v7'
folder=ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production';old_path=folder/(previous+'.json');old=read_json(old_path)
assert old['machine_id']==machine_id() and old['status']=='stopped_at_safe_boundary'
assert old['reason']=='bounded_transport_or_run_duration','No automatic continuation after user/auth/uncertain stop'
assert not (folder/'owner.json').exists()
assert read_json(folder/(previous+'-released-owner.json'))=={'run_id':previous,'machine_id':machine_id()}
assert not (folder/(following+'.json')).exists()
assert not (ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/handoff-stop.json').exists()
no_calling(ROOT)
assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/retry-scheduler/state.json')['pending'] is None
assert inspect_window(ROOT,old['after_window'],machine_id())['ready']
plan=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/after128-continuous-plan.json')['batches'];assert 0<=old['next_index']<=len(plan)
count=png=content=auth=0
for path in (ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-window-timings').glob(previous+'-window*-completed.json'):
 receipt=read_json(path);assert receipt['status']=='completed'
 resolved=[e for e in receipt['events'] if e['phase']=='image_resolved'];count+=len(resolved)
 png+=sum(e['error'] is None for e in resolved)
 content+=sum('moderation_blocked' in (e['error'] or '') for e in resolved)
 auth+=sum('token_expired' in (e['error'] or '') for e in resolved)
assert count==old['completed_source_requests'] and count==png+content+auth
spec={'runId':following,'startIndex':old['next_index'],'afterWindow':old['after_window'],'maxCalls':64,'maxPreviewBytes':6553600,'maxRunSeconds':7200}
spec_path=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-v7-spec-20261025.json';assert not spec_path.exists()
audit_path=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261025-low-v7.json';assert not audit_path.exists()
write_json(spec_path,spec)
write_json(audit_path,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'previous_run':previous,'previous_state':old,'previous_state_sha256':file_sha256(old_path),'previous_actual_invocations':count,'previous_actual_PNG_returns':png,'previous_content_refusals':content,'previous_authentication_errors':auth,'following_run':following,'following_spec':spec,'following_spec_sha256':file_sha256(spec_path),'status':'following_finite_run_prepared_owner_not_yet_claimed','user_scope':'Continue explicitly authorized LOW production using built-in imagegen; skip service-refused HIGH without clearing incomplete counts or retry consumption.','scope':'New finite transport phase only after cell532 actually finished, up to64 planned requests or2h. Prior v6 counts/deadline/receipts remain unchanged; resume actual cursor/after-window without replay. Existing a/root output reviewers only, b agent stopped. In-flight old review groups may finish; no old deadline reset. Prior unique Git-only publisher must actually finish/read back/release its lock before any new publisher starts; generation continues independently.','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
print(json.dumps({'prepared':True,'spec':spec,'previous_actual_invocations':count,'previous_PNGs':png,'previous_content_refusals':content,'previous_authentication_errors':auth,'new_image_calls':0,'owner_claimed':False},ensure_ascii=True))

"""Guard and normally allocate the existing b slot to root; no extra reviewer."""
import json,sys
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from tools.fresh_source_observation_queue import claim as fresh_claim
from tools.portrait_review_queue import wait_for_claim
phase_path=ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v6-phase.json';phase=read_json(phase_path)
assert phase['machine_id']==machine_id() and phase['current_tag'] is None
assert phase['completed_groups']<phase['max_groups'] and datetime.now(timezone.utc)<datetime.fromisoformat(phase['deadline_utc'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
run=phase['run_id'];assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json')=={'run_id':run,'machine_id':machine_id()}
assert read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json')['status']=='running'
assert not (ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/handoff-stop.json').exists() and not (ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}-stop-requested.json').exists()
assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/slot-b.json')['status']=='available'
allocation=fresh_claim(ROOT,'b')
if allocation.get('ready'):
 views=[]
 for item in allocation['sources']:
  with Image.open(item['original']) as opened:image=opened.convert('RGBA')
  target=ROOT/f'runtime/{allocation["tag"]}-{item["key"][:8]}-root-nearest4.png'
  assert not target.exists();image.resize((image.width*4,image.height*4),Image.Resampling.NEAREST).save(target)
  views.append({'key':item['key'],'path':item['original'],'sha256':item['original_png_sha256'],'size':list(image.size),'alpha_extrema':list(image.getchannel('A').getextrema()),'nearest_path':str(target),'nearest_sha256':file_sha256(target)})
 allocation.update(views=views,mascot_reference_sha256=file_sha256(ROOT/'mod_nailong/assets/reference/naiwa.png'));kind='originals'
else:
 assert not allocation.get('stop_requested')
 allocation=wait_for_claim('b',0);kind='portrait'
if allocation.get('ready'):
 phase.update(current_tag=allocation['tag'],current_kind=kind,allocated_at_utc=utc_now());write_json(phase_path,phase)
print(json.dumps({'kind':kind,'allocation':allocation,'finite_phase':phase},ensure_ascii=True))

"""One finite Git-only publisher for an actually claimed following production run."""
import json,os,re,subprocess,sys,time,traceback
from datetime import datetime,timedelta,timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,machine_id,utc_now
run=sys.argv[1];assert re.fullmatch(r'resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v[0-9]+',run)
assert int(run.rsplit('-v',1)[1])>=6
folder=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-20261025';state_path=folder/('publisher-'+run+'.json')
assert not state_path.exists(),'A prior publisher for this run requires reconciliation, never restart blindly'
prior=read_json(folder/'publisher-state.json')
assert prior['status']=='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline','Prior v5 publisher must finish its exact readback first'
for path in folder.glob('publisher-resume-*.json'):
    assert read_json(path)['status']=='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline','Another following publisher requires reconciliation'
owner=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json')
assert owner=={'run_id':run,'machine_id':machine_id()}
production=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json')
assert production['status']=='running' and production['machine_id']==machine_id()
deadline=datetime.fromisoformat(production['created_at_utc'])+timedelta(seconds=23400)
assert datetime.now(timezone.utc)<deadline
lock=folder/'publisher.lock';fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY)
os.write(fd,str(os.getpid()).encode('ascii'));os.close(fd)
state={'machine_id':machine_id(),'pid':os.getpid(),'run_id':run,'started_at_utc':utc_now(),'production_created_at_utc':production['created_at_utc'],'original_deadline_utc':deadline.isoformat(),'checkpoints':[],'scope':'Finite Git-only successor after the prior publisher actually finished/released its unique lock. No generation, output approval, canonical writes or image request replay. Normal LOW snapshots, fast-forward pushes and exact pinned original-byte verification.'}
def persist(**kw):state.update(kw,observed_at_utc=utc_now());write_json(state_path,state)
def checked(args,timeout=1800):
    r=subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=timeout)
    if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(r.stdout+'\n'+r.stderr)
    return r.stdout
try:
    last=0;persist(status='waiting_for_next_16_completed_requests',last_checkpoint_requests=last)
    while datetime.now(timezone.utc)<deadline:
        owner_path=ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json'
        live=owner_path.exists() and read_json(owner_path).get('run_id')==run
        production=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json')
        calls=production['completed_source_requests'];running=live and production['status']=='running'
        if calls-last<16 and running:
            persist(status='waiting_for_next_16_completed_requests',last_completed_requests=calls,last_checkpoint_requests=last);time.sleep(20);continue
        if last==calls and not running:break
        readback_lock=ROOT/'runtime/master-git-readback.lock'
        if readback_lock.exists():
            persist(status='waiting_for_existing_original_readback',last_completed_requests=calls);time.sleep(20);continue
        seq=len(state['checkpoints'])+1;batch='resumed-low-'+run.rsplit('-',1)[-1]+'-auto-'+str(seq)+'-20261025'
        while (ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoints'/batch).exists():
            seq+=1;batch='resumed-low-'+run.rsplit('-',1)[-1]+'-auto-'+str(seq)+'-20261025'
        persist(status='snapshotting_LOW_scope',last_completed_requests=calls)
        checked([sys.executable,'-X','utf8',str(ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoint-20261025.py'),batch,'--incremental'])
        receipt=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoints/{batch}/receipt.json')
        publication=ROOT/f'runtime/checkpoint-{batch}.json';assert not publication.exists()
        write_json(publication,{**receipt,'isolated_git_synchronization':{'status':'pending_in_separate_network_publisher','primary_worktree_untouched':True}})
        state['checkpoints'].append({'batch':batch,'commit':receipt['commit'],'completed_requests_at_snapshot':calls,'new_original_PNGs':receipt['new_original_PNGs']})
        persist(status='publishing_and_verifying_immutable_snapshot')
        checked([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'tools/production_checkpoint_publish.py'),receipt['commit'],batch])
        assert read_json(publication)['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified'
        last=calls;persist(status='checkpoint_pushed_and_raw_bytes_verified',last_checkpoint_requests=last,last_commit=receipt['commit'])
        if not running:break
    persist(status='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline',finished_at_utc=utc_now())
except BaseException:
    persist(status='stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay',error=traceback.format_exc());raise
finally:
    assert lock.read_text()==str(os.getpid());lock.unlink()

files=['runtime/prepare-low-v7-continuation-20261025.py','runtime/resume-low-v7-built-in-20261025.js','runtime/root-review-slot-b-next-20261025.py','runtime/root-review-slot-b-finalize-20261025.py','runtime/root-review-slot-b-originals-finalize-20261025.py','runtime/root-b100-detail-crops-20261025.py','runtime/root-b101-detail-crops-20261025.py','runtime/root-b102-detail-crops-20261025.py','runtime/low-scoped-publisher-following-run-20261025.py','runtime/record-low-v7-started-20261025.py']+helper_paths
